notes: All 62 distinct FBbt terms across 184 mapped clusters verified current/non-obsolete/label-match against FBbt 2026-06-11 via scripts/verify_mappings.py. Deterministic steps (annotations, 124 placeholders, collate) reproduce byte-identically from current code; the 8 pilot clusters were re-run under current agent guidance with 0 changes in FBbt assignment/match-type/flags. 12 class-C clusters held (class undefined). Sample/Assay/Clustering layer built from GEO (7 biological samples, 36 10x-library assays, 2 clusterings) with FBdv stages + FBbt tissue per curated timepoint map; FBdv 2026-04-02, FBcv 2026-04-03. Expression summary stats computed from the raw 10x matrix: CPM-normalised mean over expressing cells (level) + extent, filtered extent>0.2 -> 584,710 cluster x gene rows (expression.tsv + GSE156455_expression.owl.gz); total/filtered gene counts on each Cluster.
